editorial.blurb: A beloved Chicago gem serving authentic Vietnamese pho and classics with rich, carefully-crafted broths and impeccably fresh ingredients that keep devotees driving from across Illinois.
editorial.insiderTip: Bring cash or Zelle — they don't accept cards, though there's an ATM at the counter. Add their complimentary side of basil leaves, sprouts, and lemon to your pho for extra authenticity.
